## Task
Link the Issue or Project task. Use a closing keyword only if this PR fully completes a repository Issue.

## Changes
Describe the behavior or documentation added and list affected modules.

## Interface impact
Describe port, width, clock/reset, handshake, latency or parameter changes. Write "None" if there are no interface changes.

## Verification
State what was checked, how it was checked and the actual result. Link relevant evidence. If tests were not run, say so and explain why.

## Remaining work
List known limitations or follow-up tasks. State whether this PR contains placeholders or completed implementation.
